caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Фигурата илюстрира промяната на средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния (hidden state mean) по слоеве в модел на език, като сравнява три различни условия: преди прилагане на гейт (gate), след прилагане на гейт и базовия случай без гейт. Оста X, означена като „Layer“, представлява номера на слоя и варира от 0 до 22 с равномерни интервали от 5 единици. Оста Y, означена като „Abs Mean“, показва средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния и варира от 0 до 4.5 с равномерни интервали от 1 единица. Синята пунктирана линия, означена като „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71“, започва от стойност около 0.05 при слой 0, остава ниска до слой 10, след което постепенно нараства, с по-резки скокове след слой 20, достигайки над 4.5 при последния слой. Оранжевата точкована линия, „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05“, започва от 0, остава близо до 0 до слой 15, след което леко нараства до около 0.1 при слой 22. Зелената сплошна линия, „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04“, започва от 0, остава почти непроменена и леко нараства до около 0.1 при последния слой, като визуално е почти идентична с оранжевата линия, което потвърждава твърдението в подписа, че стойностите след гейт и базовият случай са подобни.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart, titled “Hidden State Mean,” displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across neural network layers for three distinct conditions: hidden state mean before gating (dashed blue line), hidden state mean after gating (dotted orange line), and hidden state mean of the baseline (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, marked with linear numerical ticks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4, with linear numerical ticks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat with minor fluctuations until layer 18, then rises sharply to approximately 2.6 at layer 20, and continues steeply upward to exceed 4 by layer 22. The dotted orange line remains close to 0 across all layers, showing a slight upward trend near layer 20, reaching approximately 0.1. The solid green baseline line stays near 0 throughout, with a very slight increase toward the end, reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 22. The legend indicates average values over all layers: 0.71 for before gate, 0.05 for after gate, and 0.04 for baseline.
model_annotations.English: The plot, titled “Hidden State Mean,” illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers in a model, comparing three conditions: “hidden state mean before gate” (dashed blue line), “hidden state mean after gate” (dotted orange line), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line (“before gate”) starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 10, then gradually increases to about 0.9 by layer 20, and sharply jumps to over 4 by layer 22. The dotted orange line (“after gate”) and solid green line (“baseline”) both remain close to zero across all layers, with the orange line slightly rising to about 0.15 near layer 20 and the green line staying nearly flat at 0.04. The legend indicates average values: 0.71 for “before gate,” 0.05 for “after gate,” and 0.04 for “baseline,” consistent with the visual trends. The caption notes that baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is evident from their nearly overlapping low magnitudes compared to the pre-gating values.
model_annotations.German: The line chart titled “Hidden State Mean” displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across 22 layers in a neural network architecture, comparing three conditions: hidden state mean before gating (dashed blue line), after gating (dotted orange line), and baseline (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4.5 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The dashed blue line (before gate) begins near 0.05 at Layer 0, remains below 0.5 until Layer 18, then rises sharply to approximately 4.4 at Layer 22. The dotted orange line (after gate) stays close to 0 across all layers, with a slight upward trend reaching approximately 0.1 at Layer 22. The solid green line (baseline) remains nearly flat near 0.04 across all layers, with minimal variation. The legend indicates average values: 0.71 for before gate, 0.05 for after gate, and 0.04 for baseline.
